rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server implementation by ifmelate that provides AI assistants with tools for building, managing, and deploying n8n workflows through both API and filesystem integration modes. The implementation features natural language workflow generation using LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic), comprehensive node management with discovery and connection tools, credential handling with AES-256-GCM encryption, and role-based access control with admin/editor/viewer permissions. Built with Express.js and TypeScript, it includes security features like rate limiting, request validation, and audit logging, plus automated workflow testing and version control capabilities. Designed for developers building automation platforms, teams requiring programmatic n8n workflow management, and organizations needing secure, multi-user workflow creation environments with both human-readable descriptions and direct API control over n8n instances.
